A '''Imperial technician''' was stationed at the "[[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|dome]]" on the [[planet]] of [[Lothal]] during the [[liberation of Lothal]] in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines" /> When [[Rukh]] arrived at the "dome" in an [[LAAT/le patrol gunship|Imperial patrol gunship]] escorted by two [[death trooper]]s, he ordered the technician shortly after his arrival to deactivate the planetary shield of the dome.<ref name="Family" />
